# Method: vertex()

```ts
vertex(
   x, 
   y, 
   z?): void;
```

Add a vertex to the active custom shape.
The current transform, character, color, and line state are captured for this vertex.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `x` | `number` | X coordinate in local grid cells. |
| `y` | `number` | Y coordinate in local grid cells. |
| `z?` | `number` | Z coordinate in local grid cells. Defaults to 0. |

## Returns

`void`
